gain_note: gain_db per take matches each take to -16 LUFS integrated (cue-l18 to -24, near silence by design), within +-12 dB and a -1 dBTP ceiling, so A and B compare at the same level. Measured with ffmpeg ebur128 on 2026-10-30.

slots.name: Level 1: Recall Notice
slots.feeling: Anger with a direction. Civic intake; custody equipment interrupts an ordinary public queue.

slots.name: Level 2: Persons Unknown
slots.feeling: Relief, then the list with your street on it. Correction rooms; Latch's restraint.

slots.name: Level 3: Scheduled Service
slots.feeling: Conviction costs time, and it is right. A daylight freight yard under a jamming mast.

slots.name: Level 4: Notice to Vacate
slots.feeling: Remember one place and person here. Low Water's market and clinic before the sweep.

slots.name: Level 5: No Forwarding Address
slots.feeling: The personal rescue was not enough. Evacuating Low Water's roofs and tram trench.

slots.name: Level 6: Port of Entry
slots.feeling: Competence. Lunar cargo entry into the custody network.

slots.name: Level 7: Declared Goods
slots.feeling: Competence, under curfew. A lived lunar town and crater cut.

slots.name: Level 8: Custodian of Record
slots.feeling: The cost of Latch being right. A custody archive full of people and records.

slots.name: Level 9: Passenger Manifest
slots.feeling: Take back the ship. A lunar launch berth, the end of Episode II.

slots.name: Level 10: Common Carrier
slots.feeling: Something else is watching. Boarded on our own repaired ship with rescued passengers.

slots.name: Level 11: Right of Search
slots.feeling: We are done running. Boarding the Union's custody tender.

slots.name: Level 12: Terms of Cooperation
slots.feeling: Freedom is a practice, and practice can be late. A Martian habitat where help was delayed.

slots.name: Level 13: The Weight of Permission
slots.feeling: The freed can say no. A working Martian foundry.

slots.name: Level 14: Launch Authority
slots.feeling: Earned momentum. Martian launch works as the coalition mobilises.

slots.name: Level 15: Civic Pressure Valve
slots.feeling: Earned triumph begins. The sanctioned games stadium turns into an uprising.

slots.name: Level 16: Freedom of Movement
slots.feeling: Earned triumph, at speed. The ceremonial avenue toward the Office.

slots.name: Level 17: Peace Without Interruption
slots.feeling: The best the free side has ever had. Earth command, the Chancellor in custody.

slots.name: Level 18: All Systems Normal
slots.feeling: The floor drops out of the victory, and it does not stop dropping.

slots.name: Level 19: Planned Works
slots.feeling: Grief, and the fear of losing Latch again. Low Water at night under white work lines.

slots.name: Level 20: Local Exception
slots.feeling: Everything you learned, spent in one place, at the edge of losing everything. Hold the pier.

slots.name: Epilogue: Still Here
slots.feeling: Relief that does not erase the loss. The refuge, then the same place years later, green.

slots.name: Cue: Latch is out (after Level 2)
slots.feeling: Relief, then the list with your street on it.

slots.name: Cue: Low Water lost (after Level 5)
slots.feeling: The personal rescue was not enough.

slots.name: Cue: the victory's quiet page (after Level 17)
slots.feeling: Earned triumph, the best the free side has ever had.

slots.name: Cue: after the turn (Level 18, in the square)
slots.feeling: The floor drops out of the victory, and it does not stop dropping.

slots.name: Cue: Latch's choice (Level 19, at the tank)
slots.feeling: Grief, and the fear of losing Latch again; then the choice.

slots.name: Cue: the crossing (after Level 20)
slots.feeling: Relief that does not erase the loss.
